title: Life by the Drop (SRV) — OneChart guitar lessons
tuning: Standard, no capo (the instructor names A, D, E and F#m shapes played in open position)
notes: Vocabulary tokens are <string letter><fret>, strings E A D G B e low to high. Sources: the instructor's spoken fingerings in captions.txt and the tab he shows on screen (visible at 317 s for the F#m riff). Confidence 'stated' = the instructor says it in words; 'inferred' = follows from his description plus the chord shape.

passages.label: intro_riff_slow
passages.source: captions 58-77 s: 'the intro starts on the open A string, 1 2 3 4 5 6'; riff pitches A C D D# E G in open position

passages.label: intro_triplet_feel
passages.source: same riff repeated slowly while counting triplets (captions 77-112 s)

passages.label: power_chord_A
passages.source: captions 138-142 s: 'for your A you're playing the open A string and your second fret D string'

passages.label: power_chord_D_and_E
passages.source: captions 142-156 s: D = open D + second fret G; E = open E + second fret A; 'lean up to that fourth fret with your third finger'. The transcribed audio shows the full open E shape ringing when he strums, so its upper strings are allowed too.

passages.label: rhythm_muted_triplets_E
passages.source: captions 174-204 s: the triplet rhythm demonstrated on the E chord (open E + A fret 2, adding the fourth fret). The hand track shows the index finger at frets 2-3 for the whole passage and no finger at fret 1, so G fret 1 is not allowed. Both transcribers also report B3 and E4; those pitches are the third and fourth partials of the low E string, so open B and open e are allowed but unconfirmed. D fret 2 is allowed as the two-string barre of the E5 shape.

passages.label: Fsharpm_chord
passages.source: captions 204-222 s: 'on the F minors he's just going... long strums on the higher strings'; F#m barre at fret 2

passages.label: final_chorus_hammer_pull_riff
passages.source: captions 307-325 s: 'open D, two quick hammer on to four, back to two, then a really fast hammer on and pull off'; on-screen tab at 317 s reads 0 2 4 2 (2) (2) 2 2 4 2 4; the riff resolves into the F#m barre ('you're back there for your F minor'), so that shape is allowed too
